Why do people watch, create, return—or pay?

It's a question that has shaped my career in consumer technology and continues to drive my interest in Product Analytics and Data Science.

I'm particularly curious about what user behaviour reveals, what metrics conceal, and how experimentation can help us understand what genuinely makes products better.

Outside professional work, I write about data science, technology and society. I have a longer-term interest in computer science.

You can find me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ohaydav/) or explore my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/ohaydav).
